title: We have World of Sea Battle at home...
author: FunkMunki
selftext: I've been working on a game that mixes some of the things I like about different sailing/pirate games. Started out with Codex using Sol and Astra, but after the recent announcements I decided to try some other models. I did some work with DeepSeek v4.1 Flash and now mostly Opus 5.5. DeepSeek was great for code, but is terrible at anything else for me. Opus is doing most of the visuals. I build the ships myself in ShipShaper, which allows me to export as glb. The game itself is Babylon.js and TypeScript with Node.js for the server.
